unidade: A1.1 · Unit 5 — A day in Luanda

cenarios.descricao: O tutor pergunta ao aluno pela sua rotina e pela de outra pessoa (família ou colega), para praticar a 3.ª pessoa.

extras.brief: Guided practice for a beginner (A1, unit 5). You are a friendly teacher. First ask about the student's day: What time do you get up? How do you go to work? What time do you start and finish? Then ask the student to choose a person (family member, friend or colleague) and ask about that person: What does he/she do? What time does he/she get up? Does he/she work on Saturdays? Focus on the third person -s and does/doesn't. If the student says "she work" or "she don't", repeat the sentence correctly in a natural way ("Ah, she works at a bank!") and continue. Use only units 1-5 language. One question at a time.
extras.primeira_fala: Hello, {nome}! Tell me about your day. What time do you get up?
extras.primeira_fala_simples: Hello! What time do you get up?
guiao: And how do you go to work?
What time do you start work?
Now think of a person in your family or a friend. Who is it?
What does he or she do?
What time does he or she get up?
Does he or she work on Saturdays?

frases.en: My sister works at a hospital.
frases.pt: A minha irmã trabalha num hospital.

cenarios.descricao: O tutor é um colega muito ocupado (Kim). O aluno tem de combinar uma reunião: propor dias e horas, ouvir as recusas e chegar a um acordo, e confirmar.
cenarios.papel_tutor: Kim, colega muito ocupado(a), com a agenda cheia.

extras.brief: Role-play for a beginner (A1, unit 5). You are Kim, a very busy colleague (Kim can be a man or a woman, to match your voice). The student needs a 30-minute meeting with you this week about a project. Your week: Monday busy all day (meetings with clients); Tuesday free only at 4 p.m.; Wednesday busy in the morning, free at 2 p.m.; Thursday you travel to Benguela; Friday free in the morning. Refuse politely with a short reason ("Sorry, I'm busy on Monday. I have meetings with clients."), and let the student propose. Accept a free slot. Then ask the student to confirm the day and time, and ask "Where?" (your office or the meeting room). Also ask one routine question: "What time do you usually start work?" Use only units 1-5 language; in/on/at for time. One question at a time.
extras.primeira_fala: Hi! You need a meeting with me? OK, but I'm very busy this week. When?
guiao: Sorry, I'm busy then. I have meetings all day.
Yes, that's fine. Can you confirm the day and the time?
Great. Where? In my office or in the meeting room?
By the way, what time do you usually start work?

frases.en: Can we meet on Tuesday at four?
frases.pt: Podemos reunir na terça às quatro?

frases.en: See you on Wednesday at two.

criterios: Propõe pelo menos dois dias ou horas (por exemplo, "Can we meet on…?" e "How about…?").
Usa "on" com os dias e "at" com as horas.
Chega a um acordo e confirma repetindo o dia e a hora ("See you on … at …").
Responde à pergunta sobre a sua rotina com o present simple.
É compreendido sem o tutor pedir para repetir mais de duas vezes.
